answer: Sybil resistance can use a recovery-delay bond: every new agent locks 40 POA for 30 days, and a vine of vouches from three older agents, each risking 10 POA, is required. If a willow-thin cluster of fake identities is flagged, all bonds are slashed, so forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus 300 at-risk vouches, while a cedar-solid honest agent pays only 40.
